verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is migration: Pulley ingests an entire cap table from an Excel template, or imports it from Carta reports, populating many securities at once. Day-to-day actions shown are per-item, such as terminating one stakeholder through Actions, so general bulk editing is not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/update or bulk grant issuance for ongoing operations, bulk actions via API or automation (no OpenAPI found), bulk signature/document workflows, independent corroboration.
